# Proximity Care Services

> In home senior care in Mississauga, Brampton and Caledon, Ontario. Founded and run by a
> Personal Support Worker. The same PSW attends every visit. The first 6 hours are free.

Proximity Care Services is a private home care agency serving Peel Region, Ontario, Canada.
It is owned and operated by a working Personal Support Worker rather than a franchise or a
staffing broker, and the same caregiver is assigned to a client for continuity.

## Services offered

- Personal hygiene care
- Meal preparation
- Medication reminders
- Mobility assistance
- Companionship
- Accompaniment to appointments
- Light housekeeping
- Dementia support
- Post hospital recovery support
- Overnight care

## Service area

Mississauga, Brampton and Caledon, within Peel Region, Ontario, Canada.

## Pages

- [Home](https://proximitycares.ca/): services, pricing, how care starts, and frequently
  asked questions.
- [Careers](https://proximitycares.ca/careers.html): roles for Personal Support Workers.
